# Get Shazam Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given Shazam.

## Syntax

~~~~text
shazamDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, shazam: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
shazamDetail(detail: Title, shazam: heardSong)
~~~~
